resharper_csharp_blank_lines_after_start_comment #

Blank lines in declarations — After file header comment. Measured: the subject is the run of plain comments the file opens with, and only that. A /// run at position 0 is not one — it belongs to the type under it and the oracle returns the file unchanged at both values — nor is a // that follows a #nullable, because the file has already started. Two // blocks separated by a blank line are one start comment and the gap is the one under the second. ⚠ The export sets it to 1, so this is one of the few blank-line keys whose value is not the no-op: a-file-header-comment.cs and a-file-header-comment-with-no-blank-after-it.cs both disagreed with their committed fixtures until the formatter read it.

Typeinteger
Default1
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two
TierA — the formatter reads it and a committed oracle fixture pins it
